**Maple IPTV is free**: every feature on every device, with no account and no limits.

| Device | Download |
|---|---|
| Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV, Android phones and tablets | `MapleIPTV.apk` |
| Windows 10 and 11 | `MapleIPTV-Setup.exe` |
| Mac (Apple Silicon and Intel) | `MapleIPTV-Mac.dmg` |
| Linux (most distributions) | `MapleIPTV-Linux.AppImage` |
| Ubuntu and Debian | `MapleIPTV-Linux.deb` |

**Installing**
- **Android:** allow "Install unknown apps" for your browser or file manager, then open the file.
- **Windows:** if SmartScreen warns, choose **More info → Run anyway**.
- **Mac:** open the .dmg and drag Maple IPTV to Applications. The first time, if macOS can't verify the app, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and choose **Open Anyway**.
- **Linux AppImage:** make the file executable and run it. If it doesn't start, install `libfuse2`.
- **Ubuntu and Debian:** `sudo apt install ./MapleIPTV-Linux.deb`

Maple IPTV is a player and doesn't include any channels. You need a playlist from your IPTV provider: an Xtream Codes login or an M3U link.

Website: https://mapleonlinesolutions.com/maple-iptv
